## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm package:check`
- [ ] `pnpm audit:ci`
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes, or the reason no test is needed is explained
- [ ] Docs/examples match any public API or workflow change
- [ ] A Changeset is included for user-visible changes, or the reason it is not needed is explained

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private data, or generated local environment files are included
- [ ] Backward-compatibility and fixture/regression effects are described
